followup_explanation: This was a short, well-specified request with clear completion criteria — provide an example for a given keyword. That profile matches Lapwing's self-reported sweet spot: it prefers well-defined retrieval/extraction/reformatting tasks over open-ended generative ones, and its internal eval scores on this kind of work are comparable to or slightly above Dunlin's. The query also wasn't open-ended enough to favor Dunlin's appetite for novel, high-latitude invention, and it carried a warm, friendly tone (so neither model's aversion factors were triggered). Given near-equal capability across the fleet, I routed to the model whose preference profile best fits a small, bounded task.
